llm_justification.summary: The market asks whether privately-held OpenAI IPOs by end-2026. There is no direct tradable instrument; the closest liquid proxy is Microsoft, OpenAI's largest partner, with a diffuse secondary read into AI-sentiment via QQQ. A shift in IPO odds has an ambiguous sign for Microsoft (value crystallization vs dilution of preferential economics) and is a small driver relative to a multi-trillion-dollar cap over 12 hours. Both mappings are weak, low-confidence, and well below the 700bps tradable threshold — this is best treated as 'unclear' with monitoring rather than an actionable signal.
